# Sanitized NovelAI Editor V2 export

`novelai-v2-editor-2024-sanitized.story` is derived from a NovelAI export
created on 2024-11-21 and published in
`onesecoConnect/ICLOUD-DEV-WORKSPACE` at commit
`b5c29f11eff53217a45817fb89d176d29396f1f9`, under
`localSpace/assets/CHUB_AI_JSON/Strawberry Fields Forever
(2024-11-21T11_30_31.176Z).story`.

The source had no reusable license and contained authored adult prose, so none
of that content or its metadata is retained. Every decoded current-section and
history-section string was replaced in place with text of the same UTF-8 byte
length and UTF-16 code-unit length; the outer container was reduced to the
fields the importer reads. The fixture
therefore preserves the producer's MessagePack extensions, records, maps,
bundled-string layout, section order, and history structure without preserving
the source text. It was then decoded again and checked for any remaining source
strings.

Do not regenerate this fixture with `NovelAiFixtureEncoder`: its purpose is to
exercise producer-generated serialization independently from the synthetic
malformed-input and budget fixtures.
